items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: we was playing alternating for George Lewis with Percy Humper and Emma Barry

ctx.x: Well I met you at the party a couple of times I think. The parties, but the last time I met you was here in your house, here when I was here. That guy came over to pay for the records, you know, a big question. Yeah. That's the one that came over to me. Yeah. That's a happy year going.

Yeah, well he was down there, we was playing alternating for George Lewis with Percy Humper and Emma Barry, and when they come down there, or where did he make that record, or did he made it on the bass over there in Millington, over there in Pensacola, or what did he make?
No, that record that you were on with Percy? Yeah. That was made well, it was Manny Stammon. Manny Stammon.
